cardiovascular.host_cpu_basis: psutil.cpu_percent over a 1.007 s window that ended 0.0 s ago, sampled on this module's own thread so no other reader can shorten it; the whole machine - every program running on it, not this platform alone
cardiovascular.resource_flow_basis: host CPU headroom (100 − cpu%) — spare capacity, not workload
cardiovascular.peristaltic_delay_basis: host memory percent ÷ 20 — a load index, not milliseconds

workload.basis: the platform's own running projects and open channels

cognition.basis: a LOAD reading, not cognition: derived from host CPU% and the running-project count, qualified by immune health. No cognitive engine is read

communication.basis: a label, not a signal: it names which of three cases holds - no socket is open and no project is running

immune.health_basis: health and threat are computed from 0 failure(s) in the window; 0 compliance review flag(s) are reported beside them and are NOT counted — a flag asks a human to look, it is not a finding of harm
immune.observed_basis: NO call was observed in the last 5 minutes, so the health figure is the absence of failures and not a reading of anything

metabolic.atp_basis: simulated — an ATP production/consumption model on a load derived from CPU. consumption is at most 0.10 per tick (0.1 x a load clamped to 1.0) and production at least 0.40 (0.5 x the lowest efficiency this code passes, 0.8), so production exceeds consumption at every reachable combination and the ratio only RISES to its ceiling. It does not deplete - and NOT because of the 0.5 floor, which never binds. It is not a live vital. THE REAL BUDGET, measured in wall-clock seconds of recorded run time: 360.0s of 3600.0s spent (10%) over 1 recorded run(s) — and it GATES NOTHING: the budget ships inert until WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET=true, per the Owner's ruling
metabolic.efficiency_basis: the mean of energy_ratio (the work budget's remaining share, derived from the seconds spent) and stage_efficiency
metabolic.energy_basis: 1 - 360.0s spent / 3600s stated capacity this window (the capacity is a stated assumption); the work budget is switched off (WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET), so nothing reads this figure: the energy thresholds read the ATP simulator, which cannot fall, and stay inert as ruled
